title: Grateful Dead Live at Utica Memorial Auditorium on 1981-03-13
source: Source: AKG D330BT's >Sony TC-D5M > Cassette Master  (TDK MA90) - Taped by Frank Streeter; Transfer : Cassette Master > Nakamichi CR-7A > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) > KORG AudioGate 4 > Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH >  flac 2496 - Transferred by Charlie Miller; Lineage: Wav > Adobe Audition 3 > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac24; edited and mastered SIRMick November 2017

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear audience tape captures a superb night highlighted by an epic Cassidy jam and tight Jerry/Bob interplay.
ai_review.review: All four reviewers rave about both the performance and the audio, noting that this Frank Streeter audience recording is exceptionally clean and clear. The show shines especially during a prolonged jam inside “Cassidy,” with Jerry Garcia and Bob Weir’s musical conversation standing out. No technical flaws are mentioned, making it an easy recommendation for listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (4‑5) and uniformly enthusiastic comments about both the music and the recording quality indicate an outstanding show with excellent audience capture.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as one of the cleanest, clearest, and best‑sounding audience recordings; no dropouts or muddiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert flows smoothly, building to a prolonged, stellar jam inside “Cassidy” that showcases the band’s tight chemistry, especially the interplay between Jerry and Bob.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Exceptional interplay with Bob highlighted by reviewers.
band_member_comments.Bob: Exceptional interplay with Jerry highlighted by reviewers.
